title: feat(spec, ui): a master_detail child is a tab by default; a field group puts it in the overview and the form
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu7DEUbpjVv32RTHJP1dS5Yk)_

Flow: dev-thread rule (maintainer 2026-11-20 09:22:50Z 「所有 p1 都按照新规则执行」): the card thread builds itself; L1 and the isolated L2 run in parallel at hand-back, the maintainer's 09:22Z ruling for every p1 card (deviates from contract-review.md:18 until the skill card lands).

ADR text drafted at opus under the measured quota exemption (the Fable quota was spent while it was written); the Fable L2 reviews it.

## 维护者速读

- **用户看到的变化**：主从子表（如发票明细、报销明细）默认不再自动放进记录页的「概览」和新建/编辑表单，而是和其他子表一样，作为一个带条数的页签。
- **想保留原样**：在主对象的字段分组里加一个指向子表的分组（`fieldGroups: [{ key: 'lines', relatedList: 'order_line' }]`）。这张表就出现在那个分组的位置，新建和编辑表单里也有它，点「编辑」时主记录和明细行一起改、一次保存（#35599 的功能保留）。页签里照常还有它。
- **按裁定 B**：`inlineEdit` 不再单独决定子表进不进表单，只决定进了以后用表格还是表单的样子。
- **`relatedList: 'primary'` 不变**：显式写了的子表照旧进概览，不需要分组。
- **仓库里已补分组的对象**（页面看起来和改之前一样）：示例应用的发票（`showcase_invoice`）、报销单（`showcase_expense_report`）、CRM 的商机（`crm_opportunity`，「Products」明细）。HotCRM 的项目预算明细见 objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2721，其他对象见 objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2720。
- **本 PR 是第一步（S1）**：表单里，被分组指定的子表暂时仍放在主记录字段的下面，还没有移到分组的位置。第二步（S2，新会话，`Fixes #35889`）会让表单（简单、分页签、向导三种布局）把子表放到分组的位置。

## What changes

A `master_detail` FK that declares no `relatedList` is now a **tab** of the parent's record page, with its count, like any other related list, `inlineEdit` or not. It becomes a body table only where a field group of the PARENT names it (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`, a child object name or `object.field`).

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts`): `isGroupPlaceableRelationship(field)` is the set a field group may name (unchanged: `'primary'`, or a `master_detail` with no `relatedList`). `isBodyTableRelationship(field, { placedByGroup })` is still the one body-table judgement. `fieldGroupsPlaceRelationship(fieldGroups, child, field)` reads whether a parent group names the list. `fieldGroupBodyTableRefusal` filters with the placeable test, so its accept set is unchanged. Field, object and form describes rewritten to say this.
- **Migration entry** `semantic/18.master-detail-related-list-tab-by-default` with the in-repo census, and an **ADR-0035 amendment** (status line plus a third note under the read-side table).
- **Record page**: `deriveRelatedLists` reads the parent's field groups for `isPrimary` and adds `isPlaceable`. A plain `master_detail` table a group makes a body table keeps its tab too (card item 4, `keepsTab` from `deriveRelatedLists`); a `relatedList: 'primary'` table stays body-only, as before, whether or not a group positions it. The edit state (#35599) follows the body tables, so it covers exactly the group-placed ones.
- **Forms**: `attachInlineSubforms` inlines a child only where a parent field group places it, a `'primary'` child included (ruling B: a `'primary'` child a group names now joins the parent's forms; one no group names leaves them, even with `inlineEdit`). `inlineEdit` only picks the form factor (`'grid'`, `'form'`, or the shape-picked default). The table still sits below the record's fields in the entry form.
- **Field-group help text** (`object.form.ts`, en and zh-CN bundles): no longer says the record page does not draw the placement.
- **Studio**: the field-group picker offers the same children (`isPlaceable`); the relationship inspector reads a plain `master_detail` FK as "Show", and "Show" leaves the key absent so a group can still place it.
- **os lint**: `relationship/line-items-inline-edit` suggests a parent field group instead of `inlineEdit: true`; `relationship/association-inline-edit` and `relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk` judge the children a parent group places; the field-consumer rule credits a child's inline grid columns only when a parent group places it.
- **Docs**: `data-modeling/fields.mdx`, `data-modeling/field-types.mdx` and `getting-started/common-patterns.mdx` said `inlineEdit` alone puts the child rows on the parent's form; they now say the parent's field group decides (with the group snippet), and the order example names its lines in a group. Flagged by the docs-drift check.
- **Examples**: the showcase invoice and expense report, and the CRM opportunity, gain a field group naming their lines, so their record pages and forms keep the line table.

### The split (agreed with the seat)

- **S1, this PR** (`Part of #35889`): spec rule, migration entry, ADR amendment, record page, Studio, group-named children entering the create and edit forms (below the master fields for now), and saving together from Edit.
- **S2, a new session after this merges** (`Fixes #35889`): ObjectForm slot sections for the simple, tabbed and wizard layouts, so a placed table moves to its group's place in the form. No S2 form change is in this PR.

### What S1 leaves (follow-ups)

- S2 above.
- `inlineEdit: true` now means the same as absent; retiring it is #35926.
- The non-en / non-zh-CN `metadata-forms` translations still carry the old `inlineEdit` help text: #35927.
- Skills text: the published skills still teach the old default (e.g. #35757's `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` and related text: master-detail children are a body table by default). Left for #35902; this card says not to touch skills (the #35852 topic).

## Why

Maintainer on #35889: 「主从子表我认为不应该自动申明放在概览中，除非我通过 fieldGroup 强制指定」 and 「我们已经开发好的功能也没必要作废」; ruling B on the same card (2026-11-20 17:34Z, 「明细表应该改成指看分组的定义了」): only the group definition decides, `inlineEdit` only picks grid or form.

## Verification

- `@objectstack/spec` tests green; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` 14/14 (api-surface, export-origins, reference docs regenerated).
- `@objectstack/lint`: 9351 tests green. `packages/cli/test/data-model-rules.test.ts`: 65 green.
- `ui/`: plugin-detail and the record page harness (395 files, 3671 tests) green; the directly affected app-shell files (`deriveRelatedLists*`, `MetadataProvider.merge`, `composedObjectsIdentity-11699`, the field inspector) green; the whole app-shell suite (2351 files) was too slow to finish locally beside the builds and was stopped, so CI's Test UI shards are the measurement for it.
- New and rewritten pins: the spec verdict table (placeable / body / placed body), the record page harness (unplaced md is a tab with no body table, `inlineEdit` or not; a group-placed one is a body table that keeps its tab; `true` / `false` unchanged), the edit state (#35599) on a group-placed page, `buildDefaultTabs` keeping a placed table's tab, `attachInlineSubforms` inlining only group-placed children, and the lint rules on placed and unplaced children.
- Browser (showcase on a fresh boot, HMR console from this branch's `ui/`), the expense report `EXP-DEMO`:
  - With the lines group: the Expense Lines table sits between the Report and Totals groups in the overview, the tab row still has `Expense Lines 4`, and the create form inlines the lines grid. At 375 px the table draws as cards at the same place and the tab stays on the row.
  - The lines group removed (temporary local edit, not committed): no table in the overview, `Expense Lines 4` is a tab and a rail card, and the create form has no lines grid. This is the card's first acceptance line.
  - The edit-together save on a placed table is pinned by the record page harness (`recordEditState-35599`), not driven in the browser: the seeded report is locked by its pending approval.

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@objectstack/spec/data` exports `isGroupPlaceableRelationship`, `fieldGroupsPlaceRelationship` and the `BodyTableContext` type, and `isBodyTableRelationship` takes an optional second argument)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #35902
